ValidationRule.description: PD-17, PD-18. Requires a governed loss reason on entry to Closed Lost and blocks erasing an existing one. Prospective: a historical Closed Lost with no reason stays editable.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Loss_Reason__c)), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Loss_Reason__c)))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a Loss Reason before closing this Opportunity as lost: Lost to Competitor, No Decision, Not ICP, or Product Gap. An existing Loss Reason may be changed to another value, but not cleared while the Opportunity stays Closed Lost.
